verdict.rationale: Veriff documents a first-party Zapier integration for no-code automation of workflows triggered by end-user verification decisions, and it fires decision and event webhooks automatically. The rule definition itself happens in Zapier, an external tool, or in the customer's own webhook consumer; the evidence shows no rules engine inside Veriff. Webhooks alone are developer building blocks, so credit rests mainly on the official Zapier integration. missing for 10: native in-product rule builder, documented conditions/actions configuration within Veriff, triggers beyond verification decisions, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: The Veriff Zapier integration is a no-code automation tool that connects Veriff's identity verification platform with thousands of apps through Zapier's ecosystem, enabling you to automate workflows based on end-user verification decisions.
Veriff sends decision webhooks immediately after making a decision
